_comment: Ownership-only targets for halal_allocator.py. Weights must sum to 1.0. GOLD-LED on purpose: allocated physical gold (PAXG) is the least contested store of value in Islamic finance, while BTC/ETH permissibility is genuinely debated among scholars. To hold only the uncontested asset, set PAXG to 1.0 and the others to 0.
